title: AIs Fail to Recognize Themselves and Mostly Think They are GPT or Claude

contributions.purpose: 首次系统评测 LLM 对自身输出的自我识别能力
contributions.mechanism: 10 模型交叉评测(10x10 矩阵):精确模型预测 + 二元自我识别两任务,100/500 词双语料各 1000 样本
contributions.source_quote: We present the first systematic evaluation of self-recognition capabilities across 10 contemporary LLMs through model prediction and binary self-identification tasks.

contributions.purpose: 揭示模型普遍缺失自我考虑
contributions.mechanism: 统计各模型在精确预测任务中预测自己的比例
contributions.evaluation: 10 个模型中仅 4-5 个曾预测过自己;Deepseek/Qwen/Grok 自预测率 0%
contributions.source_quote: most models never predict themselves as generators, demonstrating a fundamental absence of self-consideration in text identification tasks.

contributions.purpose: 揭示预测极端偏向 GPT/Claude 家族
contributions.mechanism: 分析预测分布的家族聚集效应并做卡方检验
contributions.source_quote: models exhibit extreme bias toward predicting the GPT and Claude families.

self_declared_provenance.quote: A notable exception is recent work by Panickssery et al. [21], which found that LLM evaluators tend to recognize and favor their own generations when serving as judges. This initial evidence for self-recognition capabilities provides important precedent for our more systematic evaluation framework.
Our study extends these research traditions by providing the first systematic empirical evaluation of LLM self-recognition capabilities across multiple contemporary models and evaluation conditions.

notes: 全文核心即负结果:自我识别近随机(精确预测 10.9%/10.3% vs 随机 10%),二元任务高准确率靠保守答 no 而非真识别(F1 均 <30%);hint 条件下结论不变(附录 A)。无明确编号贡献列表,由 abstract+conclusion 归纳。四元组适配良好。
